title: India’s central bank hikes rates for the first time since 2023 as inflation risks build
summary: The RBI has raised interest rates for the first time since 2023 amid growing inflation concerns, with HSBC and Goldman Sachs expecting further hikes in December. This signals tightening monetary policy as India's central bank moves to combat inflationary pressures. The increase reflects heightened vigilance over price stability risks.
content: HSBC and Goldman Sachs expect the RBI to raise interest rates in December as well.

zh.title: 印度央行自2023年来首次提高利率，因通胀风险加剧
zh.summary: 在通胀担忧加剧的背景下，印度储备银行自2023年来首次提高利率，汇丰银行和高盛预计12月将进一步上调。这表明印度央行正在实施紧缩性货币政策以应对通胀压力。此次上调反映出对物价稳定风险的高度警惕。

title: Singapore's Temasek warns of the ‘biggest risk’ facing markets right now
summary: Singapore's state-owned investment firm Temasek has identified the unwinding of inflated artificial intelligence valuations as the primary market risk going forward. The warning reflects concerns that excessive AI spending may not be economically justified. Market corrections could be sharp if investor sentiment shifts away from AI assets.
content: Unwinding of the artificial intelligence trade poses the biggest risk to markets, according to  Singapore state-owned investment giant Temasek.

zh.title: 新加坡淡马锡警告市场面临的"最大风险"
zh.summary: 新加坡国有投资公司淡马锡将人工智能估值泡沫的消退列为未来的主要市场风险。这一警告反映了人们对过度AI投资可能缺乏经济合理性的担忧。如果投资者情绪转向远离AI资产，市场调整可能会很急剧。

title: Oil rises as concerns over Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia eclipse supply recovery
summary: Oil prices rose as geopolitical tensions from Iran-backed Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia overshadowed modest supply increases in the Middle East. Security threats in a critical energy region can quickly override fundamental supply dynamics. The incident underscores how regional conflicts directly impact global energy markets.
content: Oil rose Wednesday, as concerns over attacks by Yemen's Iran-backed Houthis on Saudi Arabia outweigh a higher crude supply in Middle East.

zh.title: 由于胡塞武装袭击沙特的担忧盖过供应复苏，油价上升
zh.summary: 由于伊朗支持的胡塞武装组织袭击沙特阿拉伯引发的地缘政治紧张局势掩盖了中东适度的供应增加，油价上升。关键能源地区的安全威胁可以迅速改变基本的供应动态。该事件强调了地区冲突如何直接影响全球能源市场。

title: Trump set to talk to Russia's Putin 'very soon' about plague-related death in Siberia
summary: Trump has announced plans to speak with Putin "very soon" regarding a plague-related death incident in Siberia, with the CDC monitoring the situation. The high-level diplomatic engagement signals concern about transnational infectious disease risks. The communication highlights how public health emergencies can prompt direct geopolitical dialogue.
content: Trump says he will speak with Putin “very soon” over a plague incident in Russia as CDC monitor the situation.

zh.title: 特朗普计划与普京"很快"讨论西伯利亚鼠疫相关死亡事件
zh.summary: 特朗普宣布计划"很快"与普京讨论西伯利亚的鼠疫相关死亡事件,美国疾病控制与预防中心正在监测这一情况。这次高层外交接触表明对跨境传染病风险的担忧。这一沟通突出了公共卫生突发事件如何能引发直接的地缘政治对话。

title: Incredible or catastrophic? Jaguar unveils its polarising electric car
summary: Jaguar has launched a new electric vehicle two years after its controversial rebranding, continuing the automaker's shift toward EVs amid polarized market reactions. The polarizing design and strategy reflect the company's bold repositioning in the electric car era. The move demonstrates major automakers' commitment to EV transformation despite consumer skepticism.
content: Two years after JLR relaunched Jaguar into a blizzard of controversy, it has launched its new EV.

zh.title: 令人难以置信还是灾难性的?捷豹推出备受争议的电动车
zh.summary: 捷豹在两年前备受争议的品牌重塑后推出新型电动汽车,继续推进该制造商向电动车的转变,尽管市场反应两极分化。这种极具争议的设计和战略反映了该公司在电动汽车时代的大胆重新定位。这一举措展示了主要汽车制造商对电动汽车转型的承诺,尽管消费者持怀疑态度。

title: Trump isn't ‘completely wrong’: Hormuz disruption is Asia’s problem, says Singapore's foreign minister
summary: Singapore's foreign minister argues that Asian economies dependent on Strait of Hormuz energy shipments should bear greater responsibility for securing the waterway, echoing Trump's recent statements. This reflects ongoing geopolitical debate over burden-sharing for global maritime security. The position highlights divisions between developed and developing nations on defense spending.
content: Trump has said that Asian economies, which are heavily reliant on energy shipped through Hormuz, should shoulder more of the burden of keeping the waterway open.

zh.title: 特朗普并非"完全错误":新加坡外交部长称荷尔木兹海峡中断是亚洲的问题
zh.summary: 新加坡外交部长辩称,依赖霍尔木兹海峡能源运输的亚洲经济体应该承担更多责任来保护这条水道,与特朗普最近的言论相呼应。这反映了关于全球海上安全负担分担的持续地缘政治辩论。这一立场突出了发达国家和发展中国家在国防开支上的分歧。

title: Trillions are being ‘wasted’ on the AI boom, Arthur Hayes says. He’s betting on what comes next
summary: Former BitMEX CEO Arthur Hayes contends that trillions are being wasted on overbuilt AI infrastructure and is betting a market crash will trigger cryptocurrency gains. His criticism reflects skepticism about current AI spending sustainability and valuation levels. Hayes's stance highlights concerns about whether AI investment matches actual economic returns.
content: Former BitMEX CEO Arthur Hayes says the AI infrastructure boom is being overbuilt and is betting an eventual crash and bailout will send crypto higher.

zh.title: 数万亿美元在AI热潮中被'浪费'，阿瑟·海耶斯如此说，他正押注下一步会发生什么
zh.summary: 前BitMEX首席执行官阿瑟·海耶斯主张，数万亿美元被浪费在过度建设的AI基础设施上，他正押注市场崩盘将引发加密货币收益。他的批评反映了对当前AI支出可持续性和估值水平的怀疑。海耶斯的立场凸显了人们对AI投资是否与实际经济回报相匹配的担忧。
